author: Burningtaco_224
body: It seems that the server is dying with the recent drop of available places from 1000 to 500, this not surprisingly is alarming. Anyway now to my current situation I have been banned by the moderator RCMPmountie (honestly don't know if hes still a mod) for multiple infractions. The map I was on is what I would consider my "last game", if you will as it was the last map there were people I was on good terms with and was friends with on the server. Then a guy who just was apart of the pseudo spawnkilling type group showed up and slaughtered me and whoever attempted to come out of spawn so I told him to screw off and go farther back but he didn't. So with this I eventually became enraged spouting swears and other words at him that caused me to be warned by the third mod there (the other staff I was on relatively good terns with), told me to stop the mod was a relatively new mod to me so I said ok and backed off.Later the spawnkiler did it again and I became enraged again so I went into what would be my final fit of anger against a player on the server. The mod then proceeded to ban me weather it was by report or by the moderators decision I was permanently banned after 3 temp bans and I don't know how many reports. All I am trying to get at is that if I am unbanned I will keep any infractions to a minimum at all cost.

title: I have been banned

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hi.

Looking at your infraction list i have decided to keep you banned.

You simply have had to many chances and you still broke the rules. You have not shown me that you can even  follow rules. This appeal is denied.
